# apollo_graph_variant (Data Source)

Reads GraphOS variant metadata, including the visible subgraph topology for that variant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apollo_graph_variant" "production" {
  graph_id = "inventory"
  variant  = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_id` (String) Graph identifier to look up.
- `variant` (String) Variant name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable graph variant identifier returned by GraphOS.
- `subgraphs` (Attributes List) Subgraphs currently visible on the variant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subgraphs))

<a id="nestedatt--subgraphs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subgraphs`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Subgraph name.
- `revision` (String) Current GraphOS revision identifier for the subgraph registration, when available.
- `routing_url` (String) Routing URL registered for the subgraph.
